reviews.text:
We are very grateful to the entire team at LotusVet and the South Buda Vet Animal Hospital, especially Dr. Dorottya Ambrus and Dr. Judit Mészáros, who performed the removal and spaying of our dog's mammary tumor. They were very thorough and attentive even before the surgery, we received detailed information about everything, and we felt our dog was in maximum safety. They acted very carefully and professionally throughout the surgery, which was a huge relief to us. We also received a lot of attention, help and useful advice during the post-surgery treatment and control. We wholeheartedly recommend them to everyone who would entrust their pet to conscientious, competent and truly animal-loving professionals!
Regards
Mollyka
Very professional team

We were greeted by a very, very nice assistant and doctor, they treated our slightly hysterical dog in a professional manner. The results arrived earlier than the agreed time, and they called me right away to reassure me. Overall, a very nice, patient, professional team, and the whole treatment was a good experience.

We took a healthy dachshund to have a tooth pulled today. After the tooth was pulled, he woke up from anesthesia, then his circulation stopped and he died. All I can say is that they are a scam, they cannot take responsibility for the animal, they can only make a contract in front of the person, with which they take all responsibility off their own shoulders. I do not recommend them to anyone who still wants to meet their dog!

I had a problem getting a prescription refilled in the countryside. They were very helpful, even available during the long weekend. They solved the problem quickly! They are also very nice. I recommend them!

I wholeheartedly recommend this great team! They saved our cats last Saturday. If they hadn't received quick and professional help, our lives would be two more miserable pets by now. We would like to thank Dr. Dorottya Ambrus and Dr. Judit Mészáros!

We were here for the first time today. The staff and Dr. Judit Mészáros were very nice. The doctor examined Mira thoroughly and everything was discussed in detail with her. She also performed the histological sampling very skillfully.
I recommend the doctor!

We arrived at the veterinary clinic with a multiple traumatized, extremely fearful dog to Dr. Judit Mészáros. In other clinics, it was impossible to examine Roxi without extreme panic.
The Doctor, however, is simply fantastic. She is outstanding professionally, and it is rare for someone to love and understand animals so much. She does not rush, she takes the necessary time for each dog, she is patient, calm, and creates a sense of security that we have never experienced before. She does not force the situation, does not increase the dog's stress, but approaches it in a way that makes the examination as gentle as possible.
Roxi is also not an easy case professionally, as she struggles with complex allergic and metabolic problems. The Doctor's expertise and thoroughness were also fully demonstrated in this.
We also bring our other dog, Pepe, to her, who also has a complex allergic problem. We have only positive experiences in this case: she examined the dog thoroughly, put together a well-thought-out treatment plan, and all this while taking the owner's wallet into account when making the solutions.
We are sincerely grateful to the Doctor for her expertise, patience, and approach. It is rare to meet such a prepared, empathetic, and conscientious veterinarian. We recommend her wholeheartedly to everyone!

Very kind, very animal-friendly attitude. We were with my 55-kg Kuvasz, with a double paw problem. I received correct information before and after the treatment. The treatment was done very quickly and very nicely, my "baby" almost didn't notice (Dr. Attila Yurt + nurse) Thank you Dr. and Nurse (He got used to the collar in 2 hours :-) ) / Somehow the parking could be solved, maybe.../
Everyone is very kind and helpful, highly recommended for bunnies! 🤓🐰🐰

Dr. Attila Yurt and his assistant were very kind, really helpful and extremely correct. I can't say a single negative thing. I recommend them to everyone from the bottom of my heart! We brought a turtle in for repair.
This is the second time we have taken our rabbit to Dr. Attila Yurt, he is kind, patient, and thorough.

My dwarf male was misdiagnosed with a lung/brain tumor, he was sent home in serious condition by an exos doctor, saying he could breathe, he was fine, and there was nothing he could do about the cancer, (it turned out he wasn't) and in the meantime he was in serious condition, as it turned out, because we took him to another doctor that evening, he was so sick and there they found heart disease, water in his lungs, so he couldn't breathe, he was old, we didn't torture him any longer, it was almost unsalvageable, so it was time to put him to sleep. 😞
They are fast, precise, accurate! The waiting room could be a little bigger...

We were satisfied the first time, so we went to vaccinate our dog a second time. Our dog is shy, not aggressive, and tried to hang out in the otherwise relatively small treatment room. The unnamed doctor was terribly impatient and did not behave professionally (he shouted and pushed the dog down). It was shocking.. A lot depends on the dog and its upbringing, but no similar case has occurred in any other clinic since then.
I also "only" received help over the phone regarding the guinea pig, which was completely reassuring, thank you very much. 🥰 …
We had tartar removal, everything went great. Competent, professional care and kindness. I highly recommend it!

I “just” asked for help by phone.
Instead, the telephone assistant colleague gave advice, listened, inquired, provided telephone psychological support and, most importantly, tried to help us in every way possible before and after our life-saving surgery.
I haven’t been to their place yet, but it must be wonderful where people like that work.
Thank you..🤍
A wonderful, animal-loving team with a high level of knowledge. They welcome their pets in a clean, beautiful environment! Congratulations, I wish them much success in their work!♥️🐕🙏 …
Precise, kind veterinarians, very friendly clinic

They are very thorough, kind and attentive. Unfortunately, due to the adoption contract, our dog had to be neutered at 5 months old, which is a big risk for such a young and tiny dog. Therefore, unlike usual, in our case, not one, but two doctors and an assistant were present at the surgery, avoiding any risks. This was very reassuring for us. Therefore, I can only recommend DélBudaVet. Thank you for your attention and work.

We thank you very much for your attitude towards our small animals and your expertise. You are outstanding in humanity. You are also outstanding in expertise.
Thank you very much for everything!!!
They are a professional, helpful and truly animal-loving team, and their prices are realistic. I can only recommend them, they helped my cat.

We have been there twice in the middle of the night with our dog and cat. It is a beautiful place and is easily accessible.
The staff is very kind and it is obvious that they love animals. The doctors have great expertise and provide fast, professional care at any time of the day without waiting.
The prices are of course not cheap, but here we did not have the feeling that we paid a large amount unnecessarily and they did not even examine our little pet carefully.
I can only recommend them to everyone.
Very kind, professional service!
Great place! I can only recommend it.
Conscientious, caring medical team. I wholeheartedly recommend them to owners.

We have been looking for Dr. András Osvárt for a recommendation for about 3 years now and we were very happy to see him. I am extremely grateful for the patience with which he always answers my questions and the way he takes care of my dog ​​Lucy. I consider him an extraordinary professional, as do all the people who work there. They are all very kind and helpful. You can see that they love what they do and they love animals. I recommend them wholeheartedly. It also says a lot that my dog ​​always goes in with a smile, thank God he only does the mandatory ones. Thank you for your work! :)
A demanding and cultured place, with an intelligent team.

We took our elderly dog ​​for a checkup, a young doctor examined him, asked for a blood test, and after the results arrived, they misdiagnosed him and sent him to the hospital for further treatment. None of his symptoms indicated he had leptospirosis, and then they sent him for a treatment that severely damaged his liver. By the time they realized that he had kidney disease, 2 weeks had passed, so unfortunately he received proper treatment too late. So we had to put our poor dog to sleep last Saturday.
However, in terms of finances, I have to note that they charged 20,000 HUF for two days in a row as an examination fee. Another time, the doctor checked his ears and the doctor initially gave him a larger dose of medicine than our dog needed, but we agreed to give him a quarter of it and then they would do something nice in return. I'll be honest, we didn't expect them to come up with some kind of debt after that when we settled the finances the day before and we paid the "debt" as a kindness.
Update☝️
I appreciate your condolences, but I don't agree with your claim that the vaccine would have provided full protection against the above-mentioned disease, since you yourself stated that there are so many types of the disease that it does not provide full protection, so this is more like a bluff on the part of the clinic.
We chose the only affordable and sensible therapy, and according to them, you can gain a few months of better quality of life with it, and according to them, it is recommended to start it as soon as possible, so we lost 2 weeks here.
I hope you gain professional experience as soon as possible.
I remain with respect!

We took our leopard gecko to Dr. Yurt Attila on a recommendation and I must say that our little reptile received a targeted medical service that far exceeded our expectations. We met a professional, dedicated and very kind doctor. We wholeheartedly recommend him to all reptile owners!
They are very professional and kind 🥰🐩🐾🩷 …
Professional, kind, polite, helpful team

We went to Dr. Gabriella Rózsa with my little cat who has breast cancer. We are talking about a 14-year-old cat. Unfortunately, we can no longer operate on her, we have to let her go slowly. Her explanation, her correct attitude, and the professional knowledge she puts into an examination are exemplary. I highly recommend her. She answered all my questions honestly and clearly. She is a wonderful doctor. I recommend her to everyone. And I thank her for everything.

In addition to the tragedy of our beloved puppy leaving us, we received a lot of support, which was extremely good and helped us get through the difficult, heartbreaking moments.
We can only recommend the clinic wholeheartedly, it gets a mark of humanity from us!
We received kind and professional care. Thank you ❤️
A professional team provides a patient, kind service. They are prepared for every situation and take the time to care for the animals.
They are very kind and helpful! I can only recommend them to everyone! I take both my dogs there! They are very polite! 🙂 …
Hidden costs, incorrect communication..

Sensational service. Fast helpful people. Very kind to my pet.
They explained everything in detail, didn't try to burden me with unnecessary things. The prices are also very fair
Me too
They were very kind, they took care of my puppy right away, thank you again!

I would like to say a big thank you to Dr. András Osvárt and his wholehearted team for the professional and quick examinations and successful surgeries, for the understandable explanations and good advice! I have been looking for the most suitable doctor, team, and clinic for my little bulldogs for a long time, BUT finally! We are grateful to everyone, for everything! 🐶 I can and will recommend him to the fullest!

Although I don't live in the immediate vicinity, we always go here with my cat because of a previous recommendation. I initially brought her with a residual problem from an accident, and since then we have had several visits, the most recent being a neutering. Every time the assistants and doctors were kind, and they even tried to give my cat the best possible care at the most economical price. Once we had an emergency with our cat, which caused me to call immediately and they were able to see us within a few hours. I am very grateful to Dr. András Osvárt and the assistants, every time we go here I know that my kitten is in good hands with them.
They helped me with the problem, thank you very much!!
One word!! perfect!!!!!😍😍😍Zaracskam is standing in front of the door even if we don't go there😀😍I think that speaks for itself! …
